description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and operational excellence within a supportive environment.As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, and fostering a positive work culture. This position comes with a competitive salary, reflecting the importance of this leadership role within our organization. Join a team committed to providing exceptional care and making a difference in the lives of our residents.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing in a skilled nursing facility.
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000 annually, based on experience.
